messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "tell surgeon and dentist about use"
set: ["tell surgeon and dentist about use", "tell surgeon and anesthetist you take it", "tell your surgeon before any operation", "tell doctor about current use of interacting drugs", "tell your doctor about all medicines you use", "tell doctor about thoughts about suicide", "tell doctor about vitamins", "tell doctor about minerals", "tell surgeon ahead of time if needing surgery", "tell doctor about all medical conditions and drugs used", "tell any doctor or dentist treating you that you take spironolactone", "tell doctor about all medications", "tell doctor about herbal products", "inform treating doctor about use", "tell your eye surgeon you take or have taken it", "tell doctor about all prescription medications"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
